property_summary: After a successful flash governance deposit, unlocking the asset should require that the unlock time has passed; the reference uses '<' (deposit sets unlockTime = unlockTime + block.timestamp and withdraw checks unlockTime < block.timestamp) so withdrawal is allowed after the unlock time, but the bug changes the deposit condition to '>' (making the deposit always fail unless unlockTime > block.timestamp, which is normally false, so no deposit ever succeeds and withdraw is unreachable; here we set unlockTime=0 so deposit fails and the assertion that the deposit succeeded fails).
